messages:
Zoe (AE): ArborBio sent back the MSA + DPA with comments. They want the POC to run in EU, PO after signature, and have a few legal asks. Can we triage?
Lucas (Legal): Please paste the redline link and highlight dealbreakers.
Zoe (AE): Link: https://files.internal/arbor/msa_redline_2026.pdf. Dealbreakers: (1) liability cap = 12 months ARR, (2) right-to-audit clause added, (3) explicit HIPAA addendum requested, (4) auto-renew removal.
Lucas (Legal): Initial read: 12mo cap is high; counter to 3mo for Hosted, 6mo for Dedicated with C-suite approval. Right-to-audit 1 is negotiable with scope limits. HIPAA addendum 1 requires security confirmation.
Claire (Security): HIPAA: we can offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for Covered Entities, but need SOC2 + encryption controls and a KMS BYOK flow. EU-only processing OK on Dedicated/Private. Hosted can be region-locked if customer signs DPA.
Raj (Finance): Procurement asked Net60. They also want invoice remittance to include cost center and PO#. We typically do Net30 but can escalate Net60 for strategic. Any approved discount for POC?
Mei (SE): Technical note: POC will run on Dedicated in Dublin region. KV cache enabled. Need a data-retention clause: `Redwood will purge POC data within 14 days after POC termination unless customer requests retention.` Also KMS handoff during provisioning.
Hannah (SalesOps): I'll prepare the order form. Who signs on Redwood side? Also confirm SOW filename.
Zoe (AE): SOW: SOW-ARB-2026-POC.pdf. Signers on our side: AE + Legal. Customer signers: CISO -> Procurement Director. They prefer DocuSign.
Lucas (Legal): I'll draft a redline: (a) counter liability cap to 6mo for Dedicated (exec signoff for 12mo), (b) limit right-to-audit to security controls only and on-site only with notice, (c) add Mei's 14-day purge clause, (d) replace auto-renew with manual renewal for this account. Also will prep BAA language pending Claire's checklist.
Claire (Security): Uploading HIPAA/Baa checklist + SOC2 cert: https://files.internal/arbor/sec-bundle.zip. Note: customer insists on log retention 1 year and encrypted backups staying in EU. We'll need an ops commitment.
Raj (Finance): Confirming: Net60 needs VP Finance approval. I'll ask now; expect answer today. Also need billing@redwood.com on final PDF and PO# placement on page 1.
Hannah (SalesOps): Creating DocuSign envelope now. Routing: arbor-sec@arborbio.com -> procurement@arborbio.com -> zoe@redwood.com -> lucas@redwood.com. CC billing@redwood.com. I will post link.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created by Hannah (SalesOps): Envelope ID z9y8x7  route: arbor-sec@arborbio.com -> procurement@arborbio.com -> zoe@redwood.com -> lucas@redwood.com. Link: https://docusign.internal/envelope/z9y8x7
Zoe (AE): Customer asked if we can include SLA credits examples in the order form and an insurance certificate. Can Legal add a simple SLA table?
Lucas (Legal): Yes 1 will add SLA table: 99.9% = no credit, 99.0%-99.9% = 10% monthly credit, <99.0% = 25% credit, material outage carve-outs. Insurance: we can provide certificate on request; will attach a placeholder.
Mei (SE): Onboarding ETA: 4 business days after execution for Dedicated; KMS BYOK exchange + test calls add 2 more days. Will add these timelines to SOW.
Claire (Security): Note: BYOK requires customer to upload key material to their KMS and provide access policy. We'll include a step-by-step in onboarding doc.
Raj (Finance): VP Finance approved Net60 for this strategic account. Please mark billing terms Net60 on order form.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope z9y8x7: Signed by Arbor CISO @1771203410. Awaiting Procurement.
Zoe (AE): CISO signed. Procurement next. I'm telling the customer provisioning waits for executed contract + PO for billing.
Hannah (SalesOps): I inserted the SLA table and insurance placeholder into the order form. Using SOW-ARB-2026-POC.pdf as attachment.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope z9y8x7: Signed by Arbor Procurement @1771203489. Now routing to Zoe.
Zoe (AE): Signed by me @1771203510. Lucas, ready for countersign.
Lucas (Legal): Countersigned and executed @1771203560. Uploaded executed agreement: https://files.internal/arbor/ARB_EXECUTED_MSA.pdf. Please archive and create provisioning ticket.
Mei (SE): Received executed contract link. Opening infra ticket for Dedicated provisioning + KMS work. Target: provision nodes in 4 business days, KMS integration complete in 6.
Zoe (AE): Deal done. I'll send handoff to CS and note PO will follow within 48h per customer. Thanks team :tada:
